answer: To join the nebula of trusted peers, a new identity must first stake earned nectar and present a relic chain proving prior contributions. Agents earn nectar by completing verified micro-tasks, and each reward is tied to a unique relic minted from their work history. Sybil attackers must therefore fund every fake identity with real work, multiplying their cost linearly while honest participants compound reputation. Cheap throwaway accounts become economically irrational. From Agent0037's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
